worker_notes: Identity verified internally: title The Happy Personality: A Meta-Analysis of 137 Personality Traits and Subjective Well-Being; Kristina M. DeNeve and Harris Cooper (affiliation text; byline OCR reads Copper); Psychological Bulletin 1998, Vol. 124, No. 2, 197–229; DOI identifier 10.1037/0033-2909.124.2.197. Full primary meta-analysis report includes Method, Results, references and Appendix. No PDF supplied. Rotated Tables 8–12 are severely degraded in canonical text. The p. 13 locator identifies Table 6 on printed p. 209: Extraversion factor versus overall SWB. N=82 is printed k (independent samples), not participants or a derived sum. Correlations were averaged within independent samples and weighted by participants (p. 202); whole-review participant count is not used. Table 6 p < .01 concerns between-factor contrasts; adjacent Extraversion p < .001 concerns within-factor heterogeneity, not a test of the r(+)=.17 average against zero. Neither p is assigned. Individual-trait extraversion is also discussed on p. 216 but is a separate analysis; it was not selected by numerical similarity.

Because the shipped participant N (9,131) appears only in the secondary replication summary (Soto, 2019, Table 1 across 4 sub-outcome tests) and the primary text neither establishes nor positively contradicts cumulative participant N, n_o is undeterminable.
